tests.name: Multi-Level Parent Traversal to Sibling Documents Directory
tests.description: Verifies step-by-step traversal stepping up two levels from cloud-app to user home then into Documents (../../Documents/architecture-notes.md).
tests.failure_message: Failed sibling folder traversal. From /home/alex/projects/cloud-app, step up one level (..) to projects, step up another level (..) to alex, then step down into Documents/architecture-notes.md.

tests.name: Cross-Root Boundary Traversal from Subfolder to /var/log
tests.description: Verifies stepping 4 levels up from /home/alex/projects/cloud-app/src all the way to Root, then down into var/log/app.log.
tests.failure_message: Deep cross-system relative path failed. Standing in /home/alex/projects/cloud-app/src requires exactly four '..' parent hops to reach Root before navigating to var/log/app.log.

tests.name: Downward Relative Traversal from User Home to Nested Project Secrets
tests.description: Verifies descending from /home/alex down through projects/cloud-app/.env without starting with a leading slash.
tests.failure_message: Downward relative path from home failed. Do not include a starting '/' (which makes it absolute); write 'projects/cloud-app/.env' directly.

tests.name: Executable Script Permission Triplet (index.js)
tests.description: Verifies that application_entrypoint (index.js) has execute rights enabled across owner, group, and others.
tests.failure_message: Application entrypoint permissions failed. A server entry script must have execute: true for owner, group, and others, while write permissions must remain restricted to owner.

tests.name: Nginx Server Configuration Least Privilege Defense
tests.description: Verifies that /etc/nginx.conf is NOT hidden, has write: false for group and others, and execute: false across all tiers.
tests.failure_message: System config security failed. Nginx config must be read-only for group and others, and must never be executable.

tests.name: Complete Inverted Tree Hierarchy Integrity
tests.description: Verifies all 12 directory nodes have exact parent references and valid POSIX paths.
tests.failure_message: Filesystem topology tree has orphaned or cyclically referenced directories. Verify every folder has its correct parent.

tests.name: Canonical Path Formatting & Whitespace Defense
tests.description: Rejects malformed paths containing double slashes (//), unescaped spaces, or trailing slashes on file leaves.
tests.failure_message: Path formatting error: Paths must not contain double slashes (//), unneeded trailing slashes on files, or unnormalized dots.
